_note: LEDGER 2026-08-29 E10-REMEDY PIN. The hash authority: computed fresh from the files remedy() wrote, never from a number carried over inside remedy()'s own process -- see the module docstring.

row.title: the LoTTE shadow, remediated per-question and re-screened to zero
row.question: After dropping the leaked queries and the near-duplicate documents from the seven surviving slices, is the shadow ACTUALLY clean -- or did removal merely appear to work?
row.lever: per-item removal, then a re-screen with the same two instruments S0 used: protected_filter._cqa_index() over the four protected CQADupStack corpora for documents, decontam.protected_query_index() for queries.
row.slices: the SEVEN survivors of S0 (writing/dev, recreation/dev, recreation/test, science/dev, technology/dev, lifestyle/dev, lifestyle/test), ~14,034 queries. The three community-overlap slices (writing/test, science/test, technology/test) stay DEAD -- no remedy applies to a community that overlaps a protected set.
row.also_drops: qrels entries orphaned by a removed document, and any query thereby left with ZERO positives. Not in the ruling's spec; added because a query whose positives no longer exist is unanswerable by construction and would depress the shadow for reasons unrelated to any candidate. It shrinks the shadow and cannot admit a contaminated item.
row.endpoint: per-slice residual hit counts on documents and queries after remediation
row.comparator: none -- this is a screen, not a comparison
row.bar: ZERO exact and ZERO near hits, on documents AND queries, per slice. Stricter than S0's own bar, which dropped a slice above a 0.5% document near-duplicate rate. A slice that still hits is DROPPED.
row.no_survivor: if no slice survives the re-screen, E10 reopens with Dylan again; the shadow is mandatory and STOP-on-failure (LEDGER 2.3).
row.adopts: the surviving slices as a hash-pinned PROTECTED partition: never trained on, entered into protected_filter's index, and the fit list regenerated (the current 337,981 predates them).
row.use_limit: THE SHADOW IS A CHECK, NEVER A SELECTION SURFACE. It may not be used to choose between candidates, to rank arms, or to break a tie. The moment it is optimised against it becomes a second dev set and stops doing its job.
row.exempt_reason: a screen with a zero-tolerance bar reads no effect size, so no floor applies
row.authorised_by: Dylan 2026-08-29, E10 ruling (per-question remedy on the seven clean-community slices); spec at LEDGER 15, 2026-08-29.
row.plan_status: REOPENED and TIME-BOXED (2026-08-29 audit). The artifact may not be pinned, served or grandfathered. A shadow can stop a bad artifact shipping; by its own ruling it may never be a selection surface, so it cannot raise the number and does not gate D2.
